content:
I am a third year PhD student in statistics at the University of Cambridge, supervised by Rajen Shah. My research interests include high-dimensional statistics, semiparametric statistics and causal inference. I am currently working on methodology to enable the use of machine learning methods for quantifying causal effects.
Statistics Clinic. I previously provided small-group teaching for the Statistical Modelling and Mathematics of Machine Learning undergraduate courses. --I am a member of Emmanuel College. In my free time I co-organise an AI safety reading group and captain the university gymnastics team.
 Download my CV. --
